summary: Appwrite is a self-hosted backend server designed to help developers build web, native, and mobile applications. It functions as an integrated middleware solution providing foundational backend services under a permissive open-source licence.
goodFor: Developers looking to consolidate common backend services into a single self-hosted stack rather than piecing together multiple disparate tools.
watchOut: Self-hosting a comprehensive backend server introduces significant operational overhead for maintenance, security updates, and scaling.
deployNotes: Because the software relies on Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
